title: ID0416666-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P7 170000786]does not work beyond 80kW
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  The column only releases full power sporadically.
The vehicles were exchanged and stored at other charging stations
tested to rule out a fault in the vehicle
can. At other fast chargers, it was possible to charge immediately with 100kW
become.
There are now 3 vehicles in use and the performance does not work
or rarely beyond 80kW, even if only one vehicle.
Solution
:
Charger is working fine and delivered in between 130 kW and 144 kW consistently.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0416666-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P7 170000786]does not work beyond 80kW CRM:02682000030
additional_info.body:
Dear Sven Nehrkorn,
We have reviewed the logs for the reported time on March 24th and observed that only one vehicle was charging during that period. The charging session started on the DC1 outlet on 2025-03-24 at 14:13:27 with transaction ID 62083489. The EV's state of charge (SOC) was 32% at the start of the session and it was successfully charged to 100% SOC by 2025-03-24 at 16:25:14.
Throughout this charging session, the charger delivered between 130 kW and 144 kW, consistently providing more than 80 kW.
Please let me know if you have any other timestamps or if we can close this ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
